title: Wildly Charred Vietnamese Vegetable Noodles
description: A charred and shaggy Vietnamese dish featuring rosemary and namul blanch season, perfect for vegetarians, this wildly charred Vietnamese vegetable noodle dish is an energizing meal option.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium high heat.
Add the chopped rosemary to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the grated carrots, sliced zucchini, and sliced bell peppers to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the blanched and seasoned namul to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, until heated through.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and namul.
Season the noodle mixture with soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Use a kitchen torch to char the noodle mixture, or place the skillet under the broiler for 2 minutes, until lightly charred.
Serve the wildly charred Vietnamese vegetable noodles hot, garnished with additional chopped rosemary if desired.
